notes.title: Minor change - 0.2.2
notes.content:
Improved visibility of the ritual object's location.
 During the rage phase, the arrow slows down the entity for 1s.
 Fire overheats the crossbow and causes it to fire.

notes.title: Dread Church - New map ! - 0.2.0
notes.content:
Discover the new “Dread Church” map, a cursed religious camp coveted by dark spirits.

 New weapon
 New banishment mechanic.

notes.title: New - 0.1.10
notes.content:
The list of invocations is available in the tutorial tab.
 Abbadon's eye defends itself when shot.
 Various fixes and minor changes.
 Add a new achievement.

notes.title: New invocation - 0.1.8
notes.content:
Add a new summon
 A quick click will consume the hunter's vision.
 Fixed a collision point.
